title: F169.6 a card for each page: the overview
caption: The card tool draws nine cards and keeps them as files in the site's web root. The host names a page's own card in its head, by where the file is. Every picture says what it shows, and a test holds each card to its page.

cards.title: F169.6 A card for each page
cards.text: A link to any of the nine pages shows that page's own card, on the framework's own address, with a description of what the card shows.

cards.title: Every picture is described
cards.text: Each of the four sites' heads says what its picture shows, and the rule that asks six tags of a site asks for this one too. Step 2.

cards.title: The host names a page's card
cards.text: A picture named for the page's address is that page's card, with a text file beside it. The page shell writes both into the head. Steps 3 and 4.

cards.title: The tool draws them
cards.text: It starts the site, photographs its name, reads each page's words and writes a card, in flat. It writes none whose type is missing or whose words run wide. Steps 5 to 7.

cards.title: Kept, and held to the page
cards.text: Nine pictures and eight text files are committed. A test draws each page and fails when its card says something else. Step 8.

cards.title: The Overview's card
cards.text: The framework's own: the name large, its line and the site's address. Any page with no card wears it.

cards.title: Asked of the live site
cards.text: After the deploy each of the nine addresses is read as a crawler reads it. Step 9.
